svg.title: Classification threshold cost comparison
svg.desc: A validation cost curve selects a probability threshold of 0.20 instead of 0.50. On test data, the lower threshold increases false escalations from 7 to 86 but reduces missed delays from 50 to 11 and total cost from 828 to 520 cost units.
